narration: One morning, Puddle the Cloud Bunny woke up — and the whole sky was GRAY!
The rainbow had vanished! Every single color was gone. Then Puddle spotted something — a trail of little color drops falling down below the clouds!
Puddle jumped on her cloud and zoomed after them! She swooped through a twisty cloud tunnel — whoooosh — and popped out the other side!
There they were! All the color drops were stuck inside a giant glass jar — held by a giggling little cloud puffin named Bloop, who just wanted to keep them as shiny toys!
Puddle didn't get mad. She showed Bloop what the sky looked like without any colors. Bloop's eyes went wide — and he handed the jar right over!
Puddle opened the jar and tossed the colors high into the sky — and BOOM — the most beautiful rainbow ever exploded across the clouds! Bloop clapped his little wings with joy!
Tomorrow — Puddle and her NEW friend Bloop find something even more mysterious hidden inside a cloud! What could it be?
